column1: # mld group, build A (note 0009 D7.1, B10). Builder A (Claude Sonnet), 2026-11-20.
# Sources: EasyMesh through the usp-spec MCP server (doc easymesh): §3.1.2 Conventions, §17.2.75 Table 97,
#   Table 121, §17.2.100 Table 122, §17.2.101 Table 123, §17.2.102 Table 124, §17.2.103 Table 125 (text reused from
#   the packet .claude/tasks/b10-builder-b/spec-b10.md written by the previous builder A, spot-checked against §17.2.75).
#   TLV codes from the tables match em-types codes.rs:316, 320, 322, 356-361, 365-366 (0xb7, 0xbb, 0xbd, 0xe0-0xe7).
#   Upstream (pinned ba4180b, extracted copy): em_configuration.cpp:1130-1164 (0xb7 sender, ssid_len = strlen + 1 at
#   :1149-1155), :1379-1419 (0xe0 sender, SSID Length always 32 NUL padded at :1393-1394), :1439-1469 (0xe1 sender; empty
#   :1674, presence indicator copied at :1685, TID-to-link octets never written :1687), :3939-3960 (0xbb: three DPP
#   attributes), :4063-4068 (0xbd: bare JSON, no attribute header); em.cpp:2022-2064 (0xe7 sender); em_base.h:3018-3117,
#   2026-2053 (packed structs); ec_base.h:136-154 (DPP attribute ids). No sender for 0xe3, 0xe5.
#   row except UPSTREAM line 19 (0xe6 Num_Mapping little-endian) and UNSURE lines 23 (D3: all four 2-bit Direction values
#   carried) and 231 (D3: consumer decides which BSSs Num_BSS counts; the codec count = list length), and UNSURE 254
#   (0xbd, port_rule SPEC: the value is a DPP attribute; D5: raw bytes, so both the attribute-wrapped form and upstream's
#   Note 0009: D2 (raw reserved values, zero counts where a count may be 0), D3, D4 (lenient empty value of 0xe1), D5
#   (DPP/JSON content and 802.11 pass-through are raw bytes), D6 (host order -> little-endian), D8 ("one or more" -> invalid
#   at 0), A8 (a "shall" rule that governs presence makes a violating value ValueOutOfRange).
# Byte order of every multi-octet integer (hex = tlvValue only):
#   0xe6 Num_Mapping (2): LITTLE-endian; audit 19 UPSTREAM (em_configuration.cpp:1674, host order; note 0008 D6).
#   0xe6 Expected_Duration (3): big-endian; §3.1.2 (spec silent; the TU count is a 3-octet integer).
#   0xe4 BytesSent, BytesReceived, PacketsSent, PacketsReceived, PacketsSentErrors (4 each): big-endian; §3.1.2 and audit 294
#   0xe5 all nine counters (4 each): big-endian; §3.1.2 (no upstream sender).
#   Raw octet strings with NO byte order applied (carried as written, 802.11 pass-through, D5): 0xe6 TID-to-Link_Mapping
#   (2 octets per entry), 0xe7 Basic EHT-MCS And Nss Set (4), 0xe7 Disabled_Subchannel_Bitmap (2), 0xbb/0xbd value.
#   Every other field is a 1-octet integer, a 6-octet MAC, a bit-field octet, a count, an SSID or a reserved block.
#   0xb7: Num_Radio(1), Num_Radio x { RUID(6), Num_BSS(1), Num_BSS x { BSSID(6), octet {BackHaul b7, Fronthaul b6, R1 disallowed
#         b5, R2 disallowed b4, Multiple BSSID b3, Transmitted BSSID b2, Reserved b1-0}, Reserved(1), SSID Length(1),
#         SSID(SSID Length, raw) } }. Bit value 1 for BackHaul/Fronthaul means "not in use" (spec table).
#   0xbb, 0xbd: value = one or more DPP attributes (attribute id, length, JSON), carried as raw octets (D5); at least 1 octet.
#   0xe0: Num_APMLD(1), Num_APMLD x { octet {AP_MLD_MAC_Addr_Valid b7, Reserved b6-0}, SSID Length(1), SSID(raw), AP_MLD_MAC_Addr(6;
#         always present), octet {STR b7, NSTR b6, EMLSR b5, EMLMR b4, Reserved b3-0}, Reserved(20), Num_AffiliatedAP(1),
#         Num_AffiliatedAP x { octet {Affiliated_AP_MAC_Addr_Valid b7, LinkID_Valid b6, Reserved b5-0}, RUID(6),
#         Affiliated_AP_MAC_Addr(6; always present), LinkID(1; 16-255 reserved, raw; always present), Reserved(18) } }.
#   0xe1: octet {bSTA_MLD_MAC_Addr_Valid b7, AP_MLD_MAC_Addr_valid b6, Reserved b5-0}, bSTA_MLD_MAC_Addr(6), AP_MLD_MAC_Addr(6)
#         (both MACs always present), octet {STR b7, NSTR b6, EMLSR b5, EMLMR b4, Reserved b3-0}, Reserved(17),
#         Num_AffiliatedbSTA(1), Num_AffiliatedbSTA x { octet {Affiliated_bSTA_MAC_Addr_Valid b7, Reserved b6-0}, RUID(6),
#         Affiliated_bSTA_MAC_Addr(6; always present), Reserved(19) }. The empty value is the lenient form.
#   0xe2: STA_MLD_MAC_Addr(6), AP_MLD_MAC_Addr(6), octet {STR b7, NSTR b6, EMLSR b5, EMLMR b4, Reserved b3-0}, Reserved(18),
#         Num_AffiliatedSTA(1), Num_AffiliatedSTA x { BSSID(6), Affiliated_STA_MAC_Addr(6), Reserved(19) }.
#   0xe3: MLD_MAC_Addr(6), Reserved(25), Num_Affiliated(1), Num_Affiliated x { Affiliated_MAC_Addr(6), Reserved(26) }.
#   0xe4: STA_MAC_Addr(6), 5 x counter(4), then n >= 0 octets reserved for future expansion (n inferred from the TLV length;
#         no trailing-bytes error; decoder ignores them, encoder writes none).
#   0xe5: BSSID(6), 9 x counter(4) in the table order, then n >= 0 octets reserved (as 0xe4).
#   0xe6: octet {is_bSTA_Config b7, Reserved b6-0}, MLD_MAC_Addr(6), octet {TID-To-Link_Mapping_Negotiation b7, Reserved b6-0},
#         Reserved(22), Num_Mapping(2, little-endian), Num_Mapping x { octet {addRemove b7, Reserved b6-0}, STA_MLD_MAC_Addr(6),
#         octet {Direction b7-6 (2-bit value 0-3, all carried), Default_Link_Mapping b5, Mapping_Switch_Time_Present b4,
#         Expected_Duration_Present b3, Link_Mapping_Size b2, Reserved b1-0}, Link_Mapping_Presence_Indicator(1),
#         Expected_Duration(3; always present), TID-to-Link_Mapping (2 octets x number of set bits of the presence indicator,
#         in wire order), Reserved(7) }. A8: is_bSTA_Config = 1 with Num_Mapping != 0 is ValueOutOfRange.
#   0xe7: Reserved(32), Num_Radio(1), Num_Radio x { RUID(6), Num_BSS(1), Num_BSS x { BSSID(6), octet {EHT_Operation_Information_Valid
#         b7, Disabled_Subchannel_Valid b6, EHT Default PE Duration b5, Group Addressed BU Indication Limit b4, Group Addressed
#         BU Indication Exponent b3-2 (2-bit value 0-3), Reserved b1-0}, Basic EHT-MCS And Nss Set(4), Control(1), CCFS0(1),
#         CCFS1(1), Disabled_Subchannel_Bitmap(2), Reserved(16) }, Reserved(25) }. Valid flags never change the layout: every
#         field is always present and carried as found.
#   (1) Items are written in the listed order, each at its own position, except the bit-group items of rule (3).
#   (2) Item names: a prefix per list entry. 0xb7 r<i>_ (radio), r<i>_b<j>_ (BSS); 0xe0 m<i>_ (AP MLD), m<i>_a<j>_ (affiliated AP);
#       0xe1 and 0xe2 and 0xe3 a<j>_ (affiliated entry); 0xe6 p<i>_ (mapping; its k-th 2-octet
#       TID-to-Link_Mapping entry in wire order is the item p<i>_m<k>); 0xe7 r<i>_ and r<i>_b<j>_. Counts: 0xb7 radios, r<i>_bss; 0xe0 apmlds, m<i>_affil;
#       0xe1/e2/e3 affil; 0xe6 mappings (2 octets little-endian); 0xe7 radios, r<i>_bss. Written as given; only the entries listed
#       follow (a count above the listed data = overstated).
#   (3) Bit-field octets: each group is ONE octet, written at the position of the group's first listed item; flag values are
#       0/1 unshifted; a 2-bit value (0xe6 direction, 0xe7 bu_exponent) is 0-3 unshifted, placed at its bit range; a reserved
#       mask (*_rsv, *_flags_rsv, valid_rsv, modes_rsv, hdr_rsv, neg_rsv, add_rsv, ctrl_rsv) is given in octet position and ORed in
#       (absent = 0). A group none of whose items is listed is absent from the bytes. Groups: 0xb7 {bh_not_in_use b7,
#       fh_not_in_use b6, r1_disallowed b5, r2_disallowed b4, multi_bssid b3, transmitted b2, flags_rsv b1-0}; 0xe0 {mac_valid b7,
#       valid_rsv}, modes {str b7, nstr b6, emlsr b5, emlmr b4, modes_rsv b3-0}, affiliated {mac_valid b7, linkid_valid b6,
#       valid_rsv b5-0}; 0xe1 {bsta_mac_valid b7, ap_mac_valid b6, valid_rsv b5-0}, modes as 0xe0, affiliated {mac_valid b7,
#       valid_rsv b6-0}; 0xe2 modes as 0xe0; 0xe6 {is_bsta b7, hdr_rsv}, {negotiation b7, neg_rsv}, {add b7, add_rsv},
#       control {direction b7-6, default_link b5, switch_time_present b4, expected_duration_present b3, link_mapping_size b2,
#       ctrl_rsv b1-0}; 0xe7 {op_info_valid b7, disabled_subchannel_valid b6, default_pe_duration b5, bu_limit b4, bu_exponent
#       b3-2, flags_rsv b1-0}. The meaning of a bit value follows the spec table (0xb7 bh_not_in_use=1 and fh_not_in_use=1 mean
#       "not in use"; r1_disallowed=1 and r2_disallowed=1 mean "disallowed"). A case that sets a reserved mask or block: the
#       decoder ignores it, the encoder writes zero (canonical bytes = the *-clear sibling or the same fields with the mask 0).
#   (4) Widths: 6-octet MACs (12 lowercase hex digits): every item named *mac, *ruid, *bssid, sta_mld_mac, ap_mld_mac, mld_mac,
#       bsta_mac, ap_mac, sta_mac. 4-octet big-endian integers: 0xe4 and 0xe5 counters. 3-octet big-endian integer: 0xe6
#       p<i>_duration. 1-octet integers: counts (except mappings), ssid_len, linkid, ccfs0, ccfs1, control, 0xe6 p<i>_presence
#       (the Link_Mapping_Presence_Indicator octet), 0xb7 r<i>_b<j>_rsv (the reserved octet; absent = 0). Values are decimal or
#   (5) Byte-string items are hex: raw octets written exactly as given, with NO length octet in front: ssid (its length is the
#       separate ssid_len item), 0xbb/0xbd value, 0xe6 p<i>_m<k> (2 octets), 0xe7 mcs_nss (4) and bitmap (2), 0xe4/0xe5 expansion
#       (the rest of the value; hex: alone = no octets). Whole-octet reserved blocks (0xe0 rsv20 and rsv18, 0xe1 rsv17 and rsv19,
#       0xe2 rsv18 and rsv19, 0xe3 rsv25 and rsv26, 0xe6 rsv22 and rsv7, 0xe7 rsv32, rsv16 and rsv25) are written as given;
#       absent = that many zero octets; a nonzero one is ignored on decode and the encoder writes zeros.
#   (6) An item given as hex: where it normally takes a MAC, integer or bit group is a cut field: exactly those raw octets
#       are written (an empty hex: writes nothing for that item). An item not listed (other than a reserved mask, reserved octet
#       or reserved block) ends the bytes there.
#   (7) trailing=hex: raw octets appended after the listed fields.
#   (8) kind=lenient;decoded=absent (0xe1 empty-upstream): decode_value_lenient returns Ok(None); the strict decoder rejects the
#       same (empty) value with Truncated. No separate strict "empty" row for 0xe1.
#   (9) The number of p<i>_m<k> items of a spec row equals the number of set bits of that mapping's presence indicator.
# Choices (for the coordinator): (a) Every cut field, partial entry or overstated count/length is error=Truncated; octets after a
#   complete fixed layout are TrailingBytes (including after zero counts). 0xe4/0xe5 have no trailing case: extra octets are the
#   spec's "reserved for future expansion" and have spec rows (expansion-*). (b) 0xbb/0xbd: value is raw bytes (D5); an empty
#   value is invalid Truncated ("one or more", D8); a one-octet value and (0xbd) upstream's bare JSON are kind=spec because the
#   codec does not parse attribute framing. Alternative: validate the DPP attribute header, then those rows become invalid.
#   (c) 0xe6 is_bSTA_Config=1 with Num_Mapping != 0 is ValueOutOfRange (A8; spec "If is_bSTA_Config = 1, set to zero", audit 22),
#   including a mapping with presence 0. addRemove is carried as found (no rule). All four Direction values are kind=spec (D3
#   line 23). (d) 0xe6 byte orders the spec leaves open: Expected_Duration is a 3-octet big-endian integer (§3.1.2), while each
#   TID-to-Link_Mapping entry is 2 raw octets with no byte order applied; Link_Mapping_Presence_Indicator bit k vs entry order is
#   not interpreted. (e) 0xe7 Basic EHT-MCS And Nss Set and Disabled_Subchannel_Bitmap are raw octets (802.11 pass-through, audit 296
#   "copied raw"); the valid flags never gate the layout, so a cleared flag with nonzero fields is kind=spec. (f) The "valid only if"
#   fields (0xe0 AP_MLD_MAC_Addr, Affiliated_AP_MAC_Addr, LinkID; 0xe1 both MLD MACs and the affiliated MAC; 0xe7 Control, CCFS,
#   bitmap) are always present on the wire (audit 286, 290: both ends treat the flag as content validity, not presence; spec
#   UNSURE noted by the audit); a cleared flag with a nonzero value is carried raw (D2). (g) 0xb7 SSIDs: length 0, 32, 33 with
#   a trailing NUL (upstream strlen+1, audit 229, D4 NUL example), a short SSID with a trailing NUL, and non-UTF-8 octets are
#   kind=spec raw. 0xe0 SSIDs: 0, 32, 32 NUL-padded (upstream sender :1393-1394, audit 279), 33, non-ASCII are kind=spec raw. (h) 0xe0
#   LinkID 16 and 255 are reserved values carried raw (D2). (i) Zero counts are spec rows for every count here (none of the tables
#   says "one or more" except 0xbb/0xbd): 0xb7 radios and Num_BSS, 0xe0 Num_APMLD and Num_AffiliatedAP, 0xe1 to 0xe3 the affiliated
#   count, 0xe6 Num_Mapping, 0xe7 Num_Radio and Num_BSS (the last two have no explicit "omitted" sentence but no "one or more" either).
#   (j) 0xe7 five-radios and seventeen-bss pin that the port has no cap (upstream's receiver rejects more than 4 radios and 16 BSSs,
#   em.cpp:2154-2194, a policy not a wire rule). (k) 0xb7 BSS flag octets use the spec bit meaning (1 = not in use for
#   BackHaul/Fronthaul); the audit 228 sender writes unspecified bits, not modelled.
# New lenient candidates (non-spec forms an upstream sender writes; not added): (1) 0xe6 sender writes a nonzero
#   Link_Mapping_Presence_Indicator with NO TID-to-Link_Mapping octets and a fixed 19-octet record (em_configuration.cpp:1685-1690,
#   audit 18): such a TLV does not parse as spec bytes for a nonzero indicator (records misalign); with indicator 0 it is spec bytes.
#   (2) 0xe0 is sent as headerless value bytes in four messages (em_configuration.cpp:1916-1920, :2059-2063, :3768-3769,
#   :3802-3805, audit 281-282): a framing form at CMDU level, not a body form. (3) 0xb7/0xe0 senders leave reserved bits and octets
#   as stack garbage (audit 228, 283, 288): spec bytes with reserved values, already covered by the reserved-set rows.
# Coordinator correction (2026-11-20, after comparing the builds): a cut field (a hex: item shorter than its fixed width,
#   reserved blocks included) ends the value; nothing after it is written, not even an absent reserved block. A row with
#   no data items (only kind/error) is the empty value. Seven rows changed (0xe1 cut-aff-mac, 0xe3 cut-mld-mac and
#   cut-aff-mac, 0xe6 cut-tid-map, 0xe7 empty, cut-bitmap and cut-bss-rsv16); fields unchanged.
